title: Wolny 2024 thoracic ISL+SSL averaged force-elongation curve (Th1-Th12)

quantity.name: force-elongation curve
quantity.definition: authors' averaged force-elongation curve of all Th1-Th12 samples (pink "Th1-Th12" line in Fig 8); elongation from the 5 N preloaded length; last point = end of the averaged curve

source.authors: Wolny R, Wiczenbach T, Andrzejewska AJ, Spodnik JH
source.sample: 4 thoracic spines (body donors); 17 ALL, 19 PLL, 31 CL, 17 LF, 16 ISL+SSL bone-ligament-bone samples; human thoracic ligaments Th1-Th12, BLB samples

protocol.summary: Bone-ligament-bone samples (frozen -20 C, thawed in saline), bones reinforced and potted in PMMA cups; preload 5 N at 0.5 /s, 60 s relaxation; preconditioning 60 cycles at 10% strain, 1 Hz, 60 s rest; tension at constant strain rate 0.5 /s to rupture; environmental chamber 36.6 C, >=95% humidity. Failure = point where further elongation gives no force increase. Transition points I/II = start/end of linear region (<1% deviation between polynomial fit and linear approximation).
how_to_simulate: Model the thoracic ligament as a bone-ligament-bone unit with the Table 1 initial length and width
Apply a 5 N preload (defines zero elongation), then quasi-static tension along the fibres to failure
Report force at the listed elongations

extraction.uncertainty: x +/-0.03 mm, y +/-3 N (line half-width at 300 dpi)
extraction.check_notes: Embedded 300-ppi raster; axes calibrated on outer tick marks (all ticks detected); Th1-Th12 line isolated by colour (RGB ~215,105,210), legend box masked; y = median of line pixels in +/-1.5 px column window. Re-read 2+ points by overlaying markers on the figure (e.g. 1.0 mm / 3.0 mm and curve end) - all on the line. The averaged curve ends near (not exactly at) the Table 1 mean failure point; no SD band is drawn.

pass_rule.rule: model curve within the spread of the individual sample curves; compare shape against the averaged curve
